a003598e26ea9d00e48eec0d0d77da3c.overview: Fanny and Jean have everything of an ideal couple: fulfilled professionally, they live in a magnificent apartment in the beautiful districts of Paris, and seem to be in love as on the first day. But when Fanny crosses, by chance, former classmate Alain, she's immediately capsized. They see each other again very quickly and grow closer.

a020040f20cfa9032f1257e986a9399e.overview: The fastest gun in the West tries to escape his reputation.
a020040f20cfa9032f1257e986a9399e.tagline: His only friend was his gun... His only refuge - a woman's heart!

a032a05e87382cb3480baa93f7f69f96.overview: An Australian opera singer hires a husband so she can work in the U.S.  Moore sings "Minnie the Moocher" in one scene.
a032a05e87382cb3480baa93f7f69f96.tagline: From "Minnie the Moocher" to "Shubert's Serenade"...She's terrific! In a mad, merry yarn from the writer of "Mr. Deeds"

a04e95592abb00427f9c025a4491df57.overview: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.
a04e95592abb00427f9c025a4491df57.tagline: Before Sam was murdered, he told Molly he'd love and protect her forever.

a0768454cffc0f654958da3473c86f07.overview: The remarkable coming-of-age story of Stephen Curry—one of the most influential, dynamic, and unexpected players in basketball history—and his rise from an undersized college player to a four-time NBA champion.

a07d18791569cc81de27e45063f81efb.overview: When his mother eloped with an Italian opera singer, Louis Mazzini was cut off from her aristocratic family. After the family refuses to let her be buried in the family mausoleum, Louis avenges his mother's death by attempting to murder every family member who stands between himself and the family fortune. But when he finds himself torn between his longtime love and the widow of one of his victims, his plans go awry.
a07d18791569cc81de27e45063f81efb.tagline: He chopped down the family tree...

a094ea0c40f7363c9547b7ad353c33ae.overview: A gambler and a prostitute become thriving business partners in a remote Old West mining town until a large corporation arrives on the scene.
a094ea0c40f7363c9547b7ad353c33ae.tagline: The story of a gambling man and a hustling lady and the empire they fashioned from the wilderness.

a0a136c8b32972cb6ae6bb57ebecfe41.overview: Assigned to South America, US official Philip Michael Santore is employed by a counterinsurgency agency. His position makes him a target for a local band of guerrillas, and, before long, Santore is kidnapped. As a prisoner, he undergoes interrogation, shedding light on the violent situation in the country. Once the insurgents are done with their questioning, they must decide whether Santore lives or dies.
a0a136c8b32972cb6ae6bb57ebecfe41.tagline: Any resemblance to actual events or to anyone living or dead is not accidental.

a0c59332b199fbb54f3be22c3cf3db5f.overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

a0c5dd4fa5a145195eed33f2480d7991.overview: A former Imperial Russian general and cousin of the Czar ends up in Hollywood as an extra in a movie directed by a former revolutionary.

a0d069ca56d54dc9958d6b38c349e6c5.overview: A playboy marries a woman doctor then grows jealous of her male patients.
a0d069ca56d54dc9958d6b38c349e6c5.tagline: A JOYOUS REUNION OF THE STARS OF "THE LADY EVE"
